stories.title: Pakistani Military Strikes and Destroys Afghan Taliban Posts
stories.summary: The Pakistan Army conducted retaliatory strikes destroying several Afghan Taliban posts near South Waziristan and Parachinar. Security forces targeted these positions, resulting in reported casualties among Taliban personnel and forcing regime personnel to retreat.

stories.title: Pakistan and Singapore Review Aviation and Bilateral Relations
stories.summary: Pakistan's foreign minister met with his Singaporean counterpart to talk about bringing back direct flights and strengthening bilateral ties as both nations celebrate 60 years of diplomatic relations.

stories.title: Geo News and UN Women Partner for Gender Equality
stories.summary: UN Women Pakistan and Geo News partnered through the UN Women Global Media Compact to help advance gender equality initiatives.

stories.title: Iran Navy Stops Two Tankers and Destroys US Drone
stories.summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guards Navy stopped two oil tankers south of the Strait of Hormuz after they ignored radio warnings and used an unauthorized route. Additionally, Iran reported destroying an unmanned US vessel in the eastern region of the strait, though the US military has not confirmed this claim.

stories.title: FBR Clarifies Faceless Customs Assessment is Digital
stories.summary: The Federal Board of Revenue reiterated that the faceless customs assessment operates as a digital function rather than depending on physical ports.

stories.title: قطری وفد ایران کے ساتھ تعلقات اور علاقائی صورتحال پر بات چیت کے لیے تہران پہنچ گیا
stories.summary: قطری وزیرِ اعظم اور وزیرِ خارجہ کے سینئر مشیر کی قیادت میں ایک وفد جمعہ کی صبح تہران پہنچ گیا۔ ایرانی خبر رساں ادارے کے مطابق یہ وفد تہران میں ایرانی حکام سے ملاقاتیں کرے گا، جن میں باہمی تعلقات اور خطے کی مجموعی صورتحال پر تبادلہ خیال کیا جائے گا۔

stories.title: Kyoto University Hospital Performs First Stem-Cell Parkinson's Treatment
stories.summary: Sumitomo Pharma announced that the first patient received a stem-cell therapy for Parkinson's disease at Kyoto University Hospital in October. The procedure involves transplanting millions of induced pluripotent stem cells into the patient's brain following regulatory approval in March.

stories.title: Punjab Launches Complimentary Guest Relations Officer Program for Females
stories.summary: The Punjab region has introduced a free Guest Relations Officer course designed specifically for women.

stories.title: دو تجزیاتی اداروں نے اربوں ڈالر کی کرپٹو چوری کا تعلق شمالی کوریا سے جوڑ دیا
stories.summary: دو کرپٹو تجزیاتی اداروں نے ایک بڑے ہیکنگ حملے کا سراغ لگاتے ہوئے اس کا تعلق شمالی کوریا کے ہیکنگ گروپ ٹریڈر ٹریٹر کے ساتھ جوڑا ہے۔

stories.title: Zee Entertainment Profit Drops 38% Amid Higher Costs
stories.summary: Zee Entertainment Enterprises reported a 38% decline in quarterly profit down to 478 million rupees due to expenses linked to FIFA World Cup broadcasting and other programming investments, which offset subscription growth.

stories.title: Copper Faces First Monthly Decline Since June on Market Jitters
stories.summary: Copper prices dropped, heading toward a 1% decline for October and ending a three-month winning streak. The drop was driven by technology sector jitters regarding artificial intelligence spending returns, alongside higher oil prices.

stories.title: Pakistan and Saudi Arabia Expand Energy and Mining Cooperation
stories.summary: Pakistan and Saudi Arabia agreed to enhance cooperation in the minerals sector, oil storage, refinery upgrades, and fuel procurement. Additionally, Saudi Arabia launched same-day visa processing for Pakistani citizens at its Islamabad embassy.

stories.title: Prime Minister Sharif Praises Singapore's Economic Growth
stories.summary: During a meeting with Singapore's foreign minister, Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif praised Singapore's economic transformation and innovation achievements. The officials discussed increasing bilateral trade, investment, and cooperation in technology and infrastructure as they mark 60 years of diplomatic ties.

stories.title: Four Fatally Injured in AJK House Gas Cylinder Blast
stories.summary: Four individuals lost their lives following a gas cylinder explosion inside a residential property located in Bagh, Azad Jammu and Kashmir.

stories.title: Sazgar Launches New Vehicle Manufacturing Plant in the Philippines
stories.summary: Pakistani automaker Sazgar Engineering Works Limited has established a manufacturing facility in Laguna province, Philippines. The plant aims to produce about 12,000 electric and internal combustion three-wheelers annually. President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. noted the investment will aid the local manufacturing sector, create jobs, and support cleaner transportation.

stories.title: Hackers Steal Record $6.3 Billion from Binance Exchange
stories.summary: Cryptocurrency exchange Binance suffered a record $6.3 billion theft by hackers, an attack analysts attributed to North Korea. Binance paused withdrawals and promised to cover the losses using company funds and reserves, while stablecoin issuers managed to quickly freeze roughly half of the stolen funds.

stories.title: Security Forces Intercept and Destroy Five Drones in Balochistan
stories.summary: Pakistani security personnel successfully shot down five drones in the Kharan District of Balochistan before they could strike their intended target at an Albat area check-post. Authorities reported no casualties resulting from the attempted drone strike.

stories.title: West Indies Claims Advantage Over Bangladesh Following Collapse in Mirpur
stories.summary: West Indies seized control of the match in Mirpur after a batting collapse by Bangladesh was triggered by Chase.

stories.title: Tech Giants Lose UK Court Challenge Over Regulatory Data Requests
stories.summary: Meta, TikTok, and X failed in their London High Court legal challenge against British regulator Ofcom. The companies contested information notices requiring detailed content moderation data under the 2023 Online Safety Act, which carries potential fines up to 10 percent of global turnover for serious violations.

stories.title: Pakistan Gold Prices Drop Following International Market Declines
stories.summary: Gold rates in Pakistan dropped on Friday, mirroring a decrease in global markets. The price per tola fell by Rs5,100 to settle at Rs420,536, while 10 grams dropped by Rs4,373 to Rs360,541. Globally, gold decreased by $51 to reach $3,980 per ounce, and domestic silver prices also fell by Rs238 per tola.

stories.title: Government States Currency Devaluation Increased Fuel and Construction Expenses
stories.summary: The government acknowledged that the devaluation of the rupee caused a rise in expenses related to fuel, construction, and dams.

stories.title: Phillips Scores Outstanding Century to Lead Team Past India
stories.summary: Phillips achieved a notable century during a match, helping secure an 87-run victory over India.

stories.title: Pakistani Rupee Slips Upward Versus US Dollar
stories.summary: The Pakistani currency registered a slight increase against the US dollar in the inter-bank market on Friday, finishing at 276.75 compared to 276.76 on Thursday. Meanwhile, the dollar declined alongside US Treasury yields amid an AI share sell-off, and the Japanese yen traded steadily ahead of an anticipated Bank of Japan rate decision.

stories.title: Sri Lanka Inflation Reaches 8.3 Percent in October
stories.summary: Sri Lanka's Colombo Consumer Price Index increased by 8.3% year-on-year in October, exceeding September's 8% rate. Food inflation climbed to 8.8%, and non-food inflation reached 8%. Inflation has hit a three-year high since July due to rising energy costs linked to the Iran war, while the central bank maintains its rates and targets 5% inflation.

stories.title: مولانا عبدالغفور حیدری کا کہنا ہے کہ حب الوطنی کے سرٹیفکٹ کی ضرورت نہیں
stories.summary: جمعیت علماء اسلام کے سیکریٹری جنرل مولانا عبدالغفور حیدری نے بیان دیا ہے کہ ہمیں کسی سے حب الوطنی کا سند نامہ لینے کی کوئی حاجت نہیں۔

stories.title: Three Police Officers Killed in Separate KP Attacks
stories.summary: Three policemen lost their lives in distinct assaults across the KP region.

stories.title: Deadline Set for PSL 12 Player Retention
stories.summary: Officials confirmed the final date for player retention ahead of the 12th season of the PSL.

stories.title: MIT Solutions Claims President's Trophy Grade-I Victory Over SBP
stories.summary: MIT Solutions defeated SBP to capture the President's Trophy Grade-I championship.

stories.title: Binance Freezes Assets Following Massive Security Breach
stories.summary: Cryptocurrency exchange Binance is working to resolve a complex security breach impacting approximately $6.3 billion in funds. Roughly half of the affected amount has been frozen. Investigations revealed multiple breach points rather than a single compromised laptop, with the company collaborating with law enforcement and industry partners.

stories.title: Malaysian Palm Oil Rises on Bargain Buying
stories.summary: Malaysian palm oil futures increased over 1% on Friday, securing a fourth monthly gain in five months. The January delivery benchmark contract rose to 4,682 ringgit per metric ton, supported by bargain buying, technical support, and firmer Dalian palm olein and Chicago soyoil prices.

stories.title: Association Opposes Foreign Pilot Recruitment in Pakistani Airlines
stories.summary: The Aircraft Owners and Operators Association has expressed its opposition to the employment of foreign pilots by Pakistani airlines.

stories.title: Karachi Hospitals Report Surge in Influenza Cases
stories.summary: Medical facilities in Karachi are experiencing a sharp increase in patient visits as the city is struck by a wave of flu cases.

stories.title: India Fiscal Deficit Reaches 42.1 Percent of Target
stories.summary: India reported a fiscal deficit of 7.15 trillion rupees between April and September, reaching 42.1% of its annual target. During this period, net tax receipts rose to 12.8 trillion rupees, total government spending reached 25.5 trillion rupees, and the September merchandise trade deficit expanded to $30.21 billion.

stories.title: Netanyahu's bloc leads Israel election but fails to secure majority
stories.summary: Final election results show Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's coalition won 53 of the 120 Knesset seats, falling short of the 61-seat majority. The opposition bloc secured 48 seats, while Arab parties Raam and the Joint List won 19 seats combined. The outcome leads to difficult coalition talks and potential new elections, alongside a Shin Bet probe into unproven foreign funding allegations.

stories.title: Indian rupee records best monthly gain in eight months
stories.summary: The Indian rupee closed higher at 94.95 per dollar, achieving its strongest monthly gain since February. Policy interventions by the Reserve Bank of India, including capital inflow measures and steps to curb dollar demand from oil companies, supported the currency despite pressure from high oil prices and portfolio outflows.

stories.title: Indian shares snap losing streak with strong October gains
stories.summary: Indian stock indexes ended a two-month losing streak in October, driven by resilient earnings, IT sector growth, and tax-relief hopes. The Nifty 50 and Sensex rose 1.9% and 2.7% respectively for the month. IT shares surged 17.7%, led by major firms like Tata Consultancy Services and Infosys, despite gains being capped by rising crude prices.

stories.title: Pakistan reports weekly inflation drop of 0.35 percent
stories.summary: Official data released by the Pakistan Bureau of Statistics indicates that weekly short-term inflation dropped by 0.35 per cent.

stories.title: Pakistan short-term inflation rises to 11.32pc in late October
stories.summary: Short-term inflation in Pakistan reached 11.32pc year-on-year in the week ending October 29, driven by perishable food products and continuous energy cost increases. Data from the Pakistan Bureau of Statistics showed 15 essential items increased in price while 12 declined, and the Sensitive Price Index fell 0.35pc week-on-week.

stories.title: بھارت میں گائے ذبح کرنے پر تین مسلمانوں کو عمر قید کی سزا
stories.summary: بھارتی ضلع گاندھی نگر میں گائے ذبح کرنے اور گوشت فروخت کرنے کے الزام میں تین مسلمانوں کو عدالت نے عمر قید کی سزا سنائی ہے۔ استغاثہ کے مطابق انہوں نے یہ کام مالی منافع کے لیے کیا تھا۔

stories.title: US Secretary of State Rubio hosts divided G20 ministers
stories.summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio is hosting G20 foreign ministers in Atlanta for talks complicated by conflicts in Ukraine and Iran, surging energy prices, and the presence of Russia's Sergei Lavrov. Few breakthroughs are anticipated ahead of the upcoming Miami leaders' summit as deep divisions persist among member economies.

stories.title: PPP delegation urges Senate opposition to join electoral reform body
stories.summary: A PPP delegation met with Senate Opposition Leader Allama Raja Nasir Abbas to invite the opposition to join a proposed parliamentary committee on electoral reforms. Senator Sherry Rehman stated that the opposition leader will respond following consultations, building on a proposal initially announced by PPP chairperson Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari.

stories.title: لاہور میں شہری پر جھوٹا مقدمہ بنانے والا سب انسپکٹر گرفتار
stories.summary: لاہور میں چودہ ماہ قبل ایک شہری کے خلاف جعلی مقدمہ درج کر کے اسے گرفتار کرنے والے سب انسپکٹر امجد رضا کو انکوائری میں قصوروار پائے جانے پر حراست میں لے لیا گیا ہے۔

stories.title: اسکردو کے ایک گھر سے ایک ہی خاندان کے چار افراد کی لاشیں ملیں
stories.summary: پولیس حکام کے مطابق اسکردو کے علاقے مدینہ میں ایک رہائشی مکان سے ایک ہی خاندان کے چار افراد کی لاشیں برآمد ہوئی ہیں۔

stories.title: Court extends physical remand of suspect in fake US stamp scam
stories.summary: A Lahore judicial magistrate granted the National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency a four-day physical remand extension for Faheem Akram and co-suspect Naeem. The suspects are linked to a Rs35 billion fraud involving the online sale of over five million counterfeit US postage labels via a website operated since August 2023.

stories.title: قصور میں ایک ہی خاندان کے پانچ افراد کی پراسرار موت
stories.summary: قصور میں پچپن سالہ قاسم علی، ان کی اہلیہ حسنہ بی بی اور تین جوان بیٹوں آصف، ناظم اور امانت کی تین روز کے دوران ہونے والی اموات تاحال غیر واضح ہیں۔

stories.title: نہر خیام پر چھت ڈالنے کی منظوری نہیں لی گئی، منعم ظفر
stories.summary: کراچی میں جماعت اسلامی کے امیر منعم ظفر نے مؤقف اختیار کیا ہے کہ نہر خیام پر کنکریٹ کی چھت تعمیر کرنے کے لیے سٹی کونسل سے اجازت حاصل نہیں کی گئی۔

stories.title: مولانا صاحب کی تقریر کے کچھ الفاظ نہ بولے جاتے تو بہتر تھا، بیرسٹر گوہر
stories.summary: پاکستان تحریک انصاف کے چیئرمین بیرسٹر گوہر نے کہا ہے کہ مولانا فضل الرحمٰن کی تقریر کے دوران کچھ مخصوص الفاظ کا استعمال نہ کیا جاتا تو زیادہ مناسب ہوتا۔

stories.title: Lahore High Court Advises Separate Plea for Detained Sister’s Medical Care
stories.summary: The Lahore High Court instructed the lawyer of Noreen Niazi to submit a distinct application for her medical care and family visits. Niazi, the sister of Imran Khan, was recently hospitalized from prison due to declining health. The directive came during a hearing on a petition challenging the extended preventive detention of Khan's two sisters.
